name: Staff of the Magi
description: A tall staff of pale wood bound in silver and topped with a burning star.
attuned_by: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
body:
## What it does

It fights as a magic quarterstaff that strikes truer and harder than a plain one, your spell attacks strike truer, and spells have a hard time taking hold of you. It holds a great store of spells, some free to cast.

## Spell absorption

As a reaction you can absorb a spell aimed only at you, cancelling it and gaining charges equal to its level, unless that would carry it past fifty, in which case it explodes.

## Charges

It holds fifty and regains 4d6 + 2 each dawn.

## Retributive strike

You can break it to unleash everything it holds in a 30-foot sphere, with an even chance of being flung to another plane before it reaches you.

features.name: Spell Absorption
features.text: As a reaction, cancel a spell that targets only you and gain charges equal to its level.

features.name: Retributive Strike
features.text: Break it as an action and it explodes in a 30-foot sphere. Half the time you escape to another plane; otherwise you take 16 force damage per charge left. Everyone else in it makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 8, 6 or 4 per charge as they stand within 10, 20 or 30 feet, half on a success.

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 20 it regains 1d12 + 1 charges
